FLOW CONTROL — 1.1.0

Glazed Relics & Dock Instruments

A complete visual refresh for the five water-engineering blocks, with animated internals, live instruments, visible boat tethers and fixes across the supported Minecraft and loader versions.

New models & live animation

  • Current Generator: redesigned copper-and-prismarine housing, glass windows, a rotating internal impeller and an animated Conduit core.
  • Stillwater Anchor: a new relic cage with a floating, rotating Conduit cage and eye. Motion and the eye's glow ease down when the controller is inactive.
  • Flow Sensor: a new dock instrument with a top vane that follows the measured current direction and a front needle that follows its speed.
  • Hydro-Current Thruster: a redesigned kinetic housing with separate bottom-shaft and propeller animation, driven by signed live RPM wherever native Create integration is supported.
  • Mooring Post: a new timber-and-iron post, an active tether indicator and a curved rope connecting its tie-ring to the secured boat.
  • Updated blockstates, complete inventory models, textures, glass rendering and explicit emissive details. Added the required texture resources so the dormant thruster also displays correctly without Create.
  • Updated item-name translations across the release matrix.

Controllers, sensors & water handling

  • Controllers now remove active flow claims when removed or unloaded, and recreate them from their saved settings when loaded again.
  • Cleaned up stale saved controller claims without discarding saved profiles or independent Calibrator edits.
  • Staggered controller refresh scheduling and improved connected-water cache invalidation and refresh handling.
  • Bulk region clearing now rebuilds the spatial index once for the selected removals.
  • Sensor speed and direction measurements now synchronize even when the comparator's numeric output remains unchanged, keeping the vane and dial up to date.
  • Comparator neighbor notifications remain tied to actual output changes. Sensor sampling avoids repeated chunk checks for each vertical sample.
  • Preserved waterlogging on placement, rotation and mirroring. Hollow frames and the Mooring Post now use non-occluding block properties so their open models do not hide surrounding water faces.
  • Corrected legacy fluid hooks so they leave untouched flow results alone outside Flow Control regions.
  • Client flow, animation and inspection caches now clear when leaving a world or server.
  • Improved modern serialization and legacy region-owner loading, and added loaded-chunk checks to affected configuration-packet paths.

Mooring fixes

  • Accepted boat boarding now releases the tether immediately, with normal tick validation retained for unloading, despawning and other invalid tether states.
  • Synchronized the claimed boat's entity identity so the client rope follows the authoritative boat.
  • Improved nearest-boat acquisition and avoided unnecessary position corrections while holding an already stationary boat.
  • Rejected invalid saved tether coordinates and preserved vertical boat bobbing while moored.
  • Added facing-aware utility block rotation, matching selection bounds and the correct rotated tie-ring attachment point.

Optional Create support

  • Native kinetic integration is available on Fabric 1.20.1, Forge 1.20.1 and NeoForge 1.21.1 with their compatible Create builds.
  • These targets use the supplied shaft and propeller meshes through native Flywheel visuals, with a block-entity-renderer fallback when visualization is unavailable.
  • The bottom-mounted input retains RPM-based current strength and reverse-RPM flow reversal.
  • Without compatible native Create support, the same thruster block remains available as a dormant, static fallback. Its settings and identifiers are preserved, and it generates no current.

Supported releases & requirements

This update covers all nine release builds:

  • Minecraft 1.20.1: Fabric and Forge.
  • Minecraft 1.21.1: Fabric and NeoForge.
  • Minecraft 1.21.11: NeoForge.
  • Minecraft 26.1.2: Fabric and NeoForge.
  • Minecraft 26.3: Fabric and NeoForge.

Requires Streams Reflowing 2.17.3 or newer. The minimum-version requirement is retained, so newer Streams bugfix releases are not blocked by an exact-version lock. Create remains optional.

Install the matching Flow Control 1.1.0 build on both client and server. Choose the file for your Minecraft version and loader.
